findings.title: No LIMIT on the ID lookup; duplicate-ID risk
findings.description: The SELECT filters on ID without any row-count bound, and ID uniqueness is unverified (database_safety=unverified, zero-scenario review). If COMPANY.ID is not backed by a unique constraint, the CompanyResultMap mapping would fail with TooManyResultsException.
findings.recommendation: Confirm COMPANY.ID is a primary key or uniquely indexed; optionally add LIMIT 1 to the normalized SQL.

findings.title: Column list sourced from shared include fragment
findings.description: The SELECT column list is provided by the CompanyColumns include fragment. Drift between that fragment and the CompanyResultMap columns would break column mapping at runtime.
findings.recommendation: Keep the CompanyColumns fragment and CompanyResultMap in sync and add a mapping smoke test.
